verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents a drag-and-drop visual editor and a code editor (pricing), Design Studio for drafting emails, AI-generated global styles for on-brand design, and an Assets library for reusing images. Inbox previews in Design Studio point to cross-client rendering checks. Personalization is only implied by references to 'personalized Messages', and reusable email templates are not explicitly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit reusable template/snippet support, documented personalization token syntax (e.g., Liquid), detail on cross-client rendering guarantees, independent hands-on corroboration of the editor.
